test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If X + Y means X is the mother of Y, X - Y means X is the brother of Y, and X * Y means X is the sister of Y. What is the relationship of X to Z in the expression X - Y + Z?

options.text: X is the father of Z
X is the maternal uncle of Z
X is the brother of Z
X is the son of Z

solution:

Y + Z → Y is the mother of Z. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d02d8cdcd598a39b4696948dc89d1e352b5462a93cf75672664df3b00ffa3feb.png] 

Thus, X is Z's maternal uncle.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
